aboutHtml:
We're Wanganui's STIHL shop, run by John and Robert Bartley. We stock the full range of STIHL outdoor power equipment. Whether you're maintaining a property, clearing land, or keeping your place tidy, we've got what you need.

We sell equipment, service it, and keep parts in stock. If your STIHL needs fixing or tuning, bring it in and we'll sort it. Come in and talk about what you're doing. We'll help you pick the right machine and keep it running right.

Open Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 5pm, and Saturday and Sunday 8am to 2pm. Drop by and see us.
